dimensions.assessment: Affects all Medicare beneficiaries utilizing ambulance services and all ground and air ambulance providers and suppliers nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: providers and suppliers of ground ambulance services and... air ambulance services

dimensions.assessment: Directly alters payment valuations, base rates, mileage rates, and regulatory reporting requirements for emergency medical transport.
dimensions.evidence: review the relative value units, conversion factor, air ambulance base rates, and the mileage rates applied under the fee schedule

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal Medicare outlays and complex fee schedule recalculations based on cost data, labor expenses, and uncompensated care.
dimensions.evidence: reflect the costs (including labor-related costs and costs related to uncompensated care), expenses, and resources used

dimensions.assessment: Amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act by introducing new mandatory data reporting, triennial review cycles, and payment adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: For each data-based adjustment year... the Secretary shall review the relative value units, conversion factor, air ambulance base rates, and the mileage rates

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent ongoing regulatory schedules starting in 2028 with triennial adjustments thereafter.
dimensions.evidence: beginning with 2028, in accordance with paragraph (18), determine and apply updated payment amounts

importance_detail.rationale: Modifies Medicare payment structures, data collection, and fee schedules for ground and air ambulance services.
